Based on further testing trying to find exactly what scenario causes the crash, plus a quick glance at the engine code referenced by the last stack trace I posted, I think that the issue is related to playing a sound at the same time that a subviewport is being freed.

The way my game is set up, you cast spells by using a wand. The wand has multiple slots for spells and as you cast spells from the wand it cycles through the spells in each slot. Spells can optionally have a custom targeting UI element. The game is crashing when a spell that plays a sound on cast, is immediately following a spell that has a targeting UI that uses a subviewport.  `audio_listener_enable_2d` is set to false on the subviewport but my guess is that something is trying to access that viewport to check if it listens for sound and is crashing out because it has been freed during the same frame.

edit: I tried a few different configurations and I think it is more likely and issue caused when the viewport is created in the same frame that a sound starts playing.

edit2: It might be both? It is honestly difficult to diagnose more precisely from just trying things in game. Take my guess as to the cause with a grain of salt 🤷
I think this might be fixed by #91123, which would be included in 4.4 and 4.3.1.  Are you able to test your project with a recent 4.4 dev build?
Just tested in `v4.4.dev5.official [9e6098432]` and can confirm that it is fixed.
